create_fully_observable_wrapper: create a MultiGridFullyObsWrapper around a gym_minigrid env to expose the full grid as a compact 3-channel observation
use_full_obs_space: use the full_obs observation space to access the encoded grid with object, color, and direction channels for each cell
get_agent_observation: get the agent observation with the full grid encoding that includes the agent position marked in red
reset_wrapper_adversarial: reset the MultiGridFullyObsWrapper in adversarial mode to return the raw observation without adding full_obs
reset_wrapper_non_adversarial: reset the MultiGridFullyObsWrapper in non-adversarial mode to automatically include the full grid observation
